title: An analytic approach to $P$-adic diffeomorphism group and Teichmüller theory
summary: We consider a specific class of infinite dimensional $p$-adic Lie groups, i.e., a sort of diffeomorphism groups on $p$-adic ball $\operatorname{Diff}^{\operatorname{an}}(B_ε)$. It turns out that this group has a natural logarithmic structure that leads to a $p$-adic version of Teichmüller theory on diffeomorphism groups, which also presents some remarkable hydrodynamic facets.
